start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:connect-every-ai-to-one-memory-list." Make one list in the person's account the original of every AI's memories: any AI on a computer, in a web chat, on a phone or in a service writes a memory there and reads it back, and a folder on the person's computer holds a copy for apps that read only files.
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Run workflow:connect-every-ai-to-one-memory-list" with the input in the worked example.

2. The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run (row workflow:connect-every-ai-to-one-memory-list) and works through its steps in order: the-list, computer-door, harness-hooks, web-chats, phones, services, copies, proof.
3. Read what each step hands back; the last step is proof.

worked_examples.title: Connect every AI to one memory list from its first step

input.list_id: <list_id: The id of the memory list, lowercase words and dashes, for example ai-memories>
input.copy_root: <copy_root: The full absolute path of a folder on the person's computer that holds the copy folder, for example the notes folder in their home folder, written out in full>
input.copy_folder: <copy_folder: The copy folder under copy_root, starting with /, for example /memories>
input.public_door: <public_door: The account's public MCP address that web and phone apps connect to, as the account's own connect screen shows it, ending in /mcp>
input.local_door: <local_door: The address of the account's door on the person's own computer, ending in /mcp, for example http://127.0.0.1:8788/mcp>

worked_examples.hands_back: Step the-list answers with list_id, row_type, original, read_back.
worked_examples.given: The person gives: list_id, copy_root, copy_folder, public_door, local_door, ais (shown as <name> in the input).
